rv.q: Still, just in time for Halloween, the BLOOD COUNTESS is the show to see to get your gore-fest on!
With striking design and a talented ensemble, The Blood Countess brings a hidden history to light.
Dalberg's play and Brandon's staging raise intriguing questions about how myths like that of Báthory come into being.
Unfortunately, the resulting play is muddy, too long and goes into too much detail about politics and Hungarian history at the expense of clear action.
It is a gripping tale from start to finish, with layers upon layers of suspense and overflowing with tensions and mysteries.

cn.t: Critics find this feminist reimagining of the infamous Hungarian countess intriguing if uneven, praising its exploration of truth and perspective while questioning whether it fully succeeds as historical thriller or character study.
